movie.title: How the Grinch Stole Christmas!
movie.overview: Bitter and hateful, the Grinch is irritated at the thought of a nearby village having a happy time celebrating Christmas. Disguised as Santa Claus, with his dog made to look like a reindeer, he decides to raid the village to steal all the Christmas things.
movie.tagline: You're a mean one, Mr. Grinch.

cast.name: Thurl Ravenscroft
cast.character: Singer of You're A Mean One Mr. Grinch (voice) (uncredited)
